# HealthRide

> Request an ambulance in India, share your location, and follow the driver on a live map. Includes a hospital directory filtered by insurance and specialty.

HealthRide sends your browser location and emergency type to ambulance drivers registered in your city. Once a driver accepts, you see their details and live position. In a life-threatening emergency, call 112 or 108 first.

## Pages

- [Home](/): How requests, live tracking and the hospital directory work.
- [Sign In or Register](/auth): Patient, driver and hospital sign-up.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How patient, location and medical data is collected, used and protected.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of HealthRide.
